summary: Central Kootenay lookout that Canada Lookouts lists as removed, with position and elevation only; no other source found.

facts.status_note: Canada Lookouts lists the British Columbia lookout as Removed.

evidence.supports: Lookout is listed under Central Kootenay, British Columbia
Separate Blackwater lookout page is in the Northwest Territories
Notice seeking tenders to erect two steel lookout towers at Blackwater, N.W.T.
evidence.quote: Supply of labour and material for the erection of two steel lookout towers complete with cupola and lightning arrestor system.
Sealed Tenders for the project listed below

notes_for_editor: Only one British Columbia source: the Canada Lookouts listing, which gives district, status, position and elevation. Two searches returned nothing else about this lookout. The page does not write the elevation unit; it is read as metres, as in the brief's elevation_m field. Canada Lookouts also has a page for a Blackwater in the Northwest Territories (a 1982 tender for two steel towers). That is a different lookout, cited only so readers do not confuse the two. No build, staffing or fate detail was found for the British Columbia site, so the story is short; the length follows the evidence.
